hero.headline: Hey, I'm Dinchen
hero.subhead: Delhi/Gurgaon-based. I build spreadsheets that think for themselves, tinker with side projects on weekends, and have strong opinions about the Indian car market.

cards.title: What I Actually Do
cards.blurb: Officially Training & Quality. Actually spend most days building dashboards and automating reports.

cards.title: Car Market Deep Dives
cards.blurb: Entry-level hatchbacks to used BMWs and Porsches — I've researched way more of the Indian second-hand car market than my bank balance has any business allowing. Thats when i realised - I have spreadsheets. I do not have the money.

cards.title: Weekend Side Projects
cards.blurb: If I'm not working, I'm probably crocheting

cards.title: Rongsa Farmstay
cards.blurb: Live website for a homestay in Darjeeling, built and deployed end-to-end alongside my day job.
cards.detail: Designed and built a full booking website for Rongsa Farmstay — an authentic Lepcha-hosted homestay in Sittong, Darjeeling. Includes a homepage, rooms & pricing, gallery, and a WhatsApp-based booking flow, deployed live on GitHub Pages.

cards.title: Personal Finance Dashboard
cards.blurb: Tracks my own salary, bills, and savings. INR, obviously.

cards.title: This Website
cards.blurb: Yes, the Netflix thing you're looking at right now. I built it myself.
